findings: The transverse and washer checks do not establish physical non-passage or retention. `genuine_non_passage` is defined only as the negation of a certified passage, so a body that penetrates or tunnels through a rib is counted as successful non-passage because its negative rib clearance makes `genuine_full_body_aperture_passage` false. Although `ever_fully_below_floor` and `final_full_collider_above_floor` are recorded, neither is included in the aggregate checks. Require retained bodies to remain physically above the floor (and reject penetration/tunneling or below-floor outcomes) before reporting the transverse/washer fractions as passing.

The plan summary claims conservative washer-OD retention, but the current qualification logic can pass all washer trials even when every proxy falls through solid rib geometry. Rename the measurement as uncertified-passage rejection or, preferably, implement an explicit retention predicate using the native pose trace and collision/penetration evidence. Keep this discovery proxy distinct from segmented-washer qualification.
